#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

class InputReader {
private:
    istream& stream;
    char buf[8192];
    int curChar;
    int snumChars;

public:
    InputReader(istream& s) : stream(s), curChar(0), snumChars(0) {}

    int snext() {
        if (snumChars == -1) {
            throw ios_base::failure("Input mismatch");
        }
        if (curChar >= snumChars) {
            curChar = 0;
            stream.read(buf, sizeof(buf));
            snumChars = stream.gcount();
            if (snumChars <= 0) {
                return -1;
            }
        }
        return buf[curChar++];
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int c = snext();
        while (isSpaceChar(c)) {
            c = snext();
        }
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;
            c = snext();
        }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') {
                throw ios_base::failure("Input mismatch");
            }
            res *= 10;
            res += c - '0';
            c = snext();
        } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
        return res * sgn;
    }

    bool isSpaceChar(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    InputReader in(cin);
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int B = in.nextInt();
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        a[i] = in.nextInt();
    }
    
    int ce = 0, co = 0;
    vector<int> count;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        if (a[i] % 2 == 0) {
            ce++;
        } else {
            co++;
        }
        
        if (co == ce) {
            count.push_back(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]));
        }
    }
    
    sort(count.begin(), count.end());
    
    int sum = 0;
    int cou = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < count.size(); i++) {
        sum += count[i];
        if (sum > B) {
            break;
        }
        cou++;
    }
    
    cout << cou << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
